absorbed_negative_result.finding: The first implementation allowed evaluator-side exact hidden goal labels even when the declared public evidence did not identify a unique goal, so an arbitrary exact guess could be scored correct despite observational non-identifiability.
absorbed_negative_result.repair: Evaluator labels are now sealed against the exact inference/run/fixture/episode/observation/candidate identities and public-identifiability digest; ambiguous public evidence cannot mint an exact GOAL label, while uniquely identifying public evidence cannot be contradicted by the evaluator label.

ABSTAIN preserved for non-identifiable public evidence
sealed labels bind exact inference and run identity
hidden fixture mutation cannot change public policy output
